primaryTextChecks.text: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

context.text: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”

geographicalEvidence.reasonJa: 古代ユダ地方の町として知られるが、士師記のデビルに対応する遺跡の確定には別途慎重さが必要。

wikipediaRead.supportingParaphraseJa: 一覧のDebir [of Judah 1]はユダの町として記載され、別行でキルヤト・セフェルとキルヤト・サンナが同じ町とされる。Debirの候補地は複数提示され、同名の別Debir行もある。

reuseCheck.detail: JDG 1:11 itself gives the earlier name Kiriath Sepher. The read table equates Kirjath-Sepher with Debir [of Judah 1]; multiple site proposals remain, so no coordinate is promoted.
